The rank-one defect I-S_B* S_B=v⊗v follows from projecting zf onto BH2; backward-shift tails give exactly the finite Taylor-coefficient weighted sum. Rank <=k forces N-k unit singulars; det(S_B^k) has modulus |B(0)|^k. AM–GM for p>0 is sharp only when all remaining k singulars equal r, equivalent via p=2 to vanishing initial jets. The Frostman transform is an inner disk automorphism and gives the complete finite Blaschke factorization. Repeated zeros are handled without a kernel-eigenbasis assumption. 338 finite checker assertions passed, but are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The function-theoretic parameter B(0) fixes a natural determinant constraint on all finite model compressions. The theorem jointly solves all finite positive Schatten p-sum minimizations of every admissible compressed shift power, determines every minimizer via finite inner-factorization, gives an exact weighted jet-energy stability remainder at p=2, and forces regular polygon geometry at full power. This is a natural global finite-dimensional classification and a structural equality theorem; a standalone AM–GM estimate would not by itself have sufficient value.
